title: Down-Payment Share Schedule for Fleet Late Balance Fees
content:
Schedule for Vehicle Purchase Agreements, Fleet Vehicle Purchase Agreement. A buyer who put money down on the deal earns a down-payment share on the fleet late balance fee.

**Schedule clause.** The deposits applied to the deal at delivery are compared with the vehicle price charged on the deal, which is the amount posted as the vehicle price charge.
- Where the deposits applied total **at least 10 percent (0.1)** of the vehicle price charged, the share is **0.85 (85 percent)**.
- Where they total **at least 4 percent (0.04) but less than 10 percent** of it, the share is **0.95 (95 percent)**.
- Otherwise no down-payment share applies.

| Deposits applied at delivery, as a part of the vehicle price charged | Down-payment share |
|---|---|
| 10 percent or more | 0.85 |
| 4 percent or more, under 10 percent | 0.95 |
| under 4 percent, or no deposit applied | none |

### Illustrations (hypothetical unit, vehicle price charged 52,000.00)
- Deposits applied at delivery 5,200.00, exactly 10 percent: share 0.85.
- Deposits applied 5,199.99, just under 10 percent: share 0.95.
- Deposits applied 2,080.00, exactly 4 percent: share 0.95.
- Deposits applied 2,079.99, just under 4 percent: no down-payment share.

### Notes on the records
- Only deposits applied to the deal on delivery count; other payments on the deal do not.
- The comparison base is the vehicle price charge posted on the deal, not the balance due or the amount financed.
